name: Docker
author: Andre Avila
description: Container status as a mosaic in the bar, one cell per container, with CPU and memory cycling beside it.

barWidget.description: One cell per container, coloured by state; click for stacks, restart and logs.

schema.label: Left click opens
schema.description: popup shows stacks and actions; lazydocker skips straight to the TUI. Middle click always opens lazydocker.

schema.label: Container engine
schema.description: auto prefers docker when both are installed.

schema.label: One cell per
schema.description: auto switches to stacks once there are more containers than the cell limit.

schema.label: Gap between cells
schema.description: Space between cells of the same stack. Keep this at 2 or more: the bar can place the widget on a half pixel, and a 1px gap then rounds away between some cells, which makes them look fused.

schema.label: Cell size (px)
schema.description: A smaller cell fits more rows into the same bar, so the mosaic gets much narrower, not just smaller.

schema.label: Space between stacks (px)
schema.description: Extra space marking where one compose stack ends and the next begins.

schema.label: Group containers by stack
schema.description: Off lays every container out in plain balanced rows, with no stack boundaries.

schema.label: Width budget (px)
schema.description: Above this the mosaic collapses to one cell per stack, and then to a single block.

schema.label: Pulse restarting containers
schema.description: The only movement in the widget, kept for the state that otherwise goes unnoticed.

schema.label: Metrics to cycle
schema.description: Comma separated, in order: cpu, mem, memPerc, net, count. Empty hides the label.

schema.label: CPU/memory sampling (ms)
schema.description: docker stats costs seconds on a busy machine. Sampling faster than this buys nothing.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: When a container turns unhealthy, starts looping on restart, or exits with an error — and once when it recovers.

schema.label: State safety poll (ms)
schema.description: Backstop in case the docker events stream dies quietly.
